notes.note: Reviewed the local CacheAwareTokenComponents type import required by UsageObservation after the helper extraction. Re-exporting a type does not bind it locally; the new import restores the existing optional token fields. The shared type lane passed, and TypeScript transpilation proves emitted JavaScript byte-identical. Existing provider, cache, context, allocation and refusal declarations remain unchanged; no prose change is needed.
